changes.title: Aggro sound
items: When a wild area's creatures stop and stare at you, a low warning rises until they attack, and falls away if you leave first

changes.title: Faster start
items: The game gets going faster: the dancefloor's light patterns for every area are made about three times as fast as it loads.

changes.title: Aggro rise
items: Wild animals now take longer to make up their minds when you land among them, reddening as they do, and the screen edges with them, more in a dangerous area; fly off or walk away before they turn fully red and they settle back down
